blurb: Guests board an authentic paddlewheel riverboat to enjoy dining cruises with buffets and live music, sightseeing cruises with narration and live music, and special event cruises. Cruises offer indoor Victorian dining rooms and outdoor promenade decks with views of Nashville's skyline. Options include dinner, brunch, holiday, and private corporate events.
extraNote: All reservations are non-refundable and non-transferable once payment is made · Optional Trip Protection available for $10 per person allowing cancellation up to 24 hours before departure · Cruises operate rain or shine following U.S. Coast Guard guidelines · Gratuity of $10 per adult and $5 per child collected on dinner cruises · No outside food or drinks allowed onboard · Smoking is not allowed onboard · Riverfront at the foot of Broadway, West Bank Commercial Dock, 100 1st Ave S, Nashville, TN 37201
